verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a marketplace search that filters by GPU type, with examples selecting RTX 4090s, and a Secure Cloud tier of verified datacenter machines. That covers choosing among GPU models, including cheaper consumer and previous-generation cards (RTX 4090, and RTX 3090 per community reports). However, nothing in the evidence names H100, H200, B200 or any current-generation datacenter GPU as available. missing for 10: evidence that H100/H200/B200-class GPUs are offered, evidence of their availability or pricing next to older generations, independent corroboration of the datacenter GPU range.
